notes.content:
已修复：
1，剧情播片时按Esc键导致画面卡住的问题。
2，修正了“魔鬼加特林”商品名称显示错误的问题。

--------------------------------------------------------------------
Fixed issues:
1. Pressing the Esc key during a cutscene would cause the screen to freeze.
2. The display error of the item name “Demon Gatling” has been corrected.


3月份了，但是也一样可以玩过年游戏！因为严格来讲这一整年都是新年！
It’s March, but we can still play the New Year games! Because technically, the whole year is the New Year!

1.2.4.3
更新公告

已修复问题：
1，父亲和舅舅在游戏结束后仍然出现的问题；
2，舅舅有概率被传送到远离场景左侧的问题。

-------------------------------------------------------------------------
1.2.4.3
Update Notes

Fixed Issues:
1, Fixed an issue where the father and uncle would still appear after the game ended;
2, Fixed an issue where the uncle had a chance to be teleported far to the left side of the scene.

1.2.4.2

[b]已修复：[/b]  
1. 儿童绘本有概率不能召唤妹妹；  
2. 教程中“来”字描述为在左上角，而实际应在右上角。  

[b]已优化：[/b]  
- 对白 UI 的位置在特定分辨率下位置错误的问题。  

[b]已修改：[/b]  
- 为了符合习俗，财神在初五也会出现。  

[b]PS:[/b] 如有任何 bug 或问题，请在更新公告中反馈，我会尽快处理。  

---



[b]Fixed:[/b]  
1. The children's picture book had a chance of failing to summon the sister.  
2. In the tutorial, the character "来" (lái) was described as being in the top-left corner, while it should actually be in the top-right corner.  

[b]Optimized:[/b]  
- The position of the dialogue UI was incorrect under specific resolutions.  

[b]Modified:[/b]  
- To align with traditions, the God of Wealth will now also appear on the fifth day of the Lunar New Year.  

[b]PS:[/b] If you encounter any bugs or issues, please report them in the update announcement, and I will address them as soon as possible.

移除了右下角恼人的水印，但我也不知道是怎么做到的。
Removed the annoying watermark bottom right without knowing how.
